items.summary: Matrix-Game-4's three -sage presets (rtx5090-sage, rtx5080-sage, rtx5070ti-sage) call SageAttention 2.2 CUDA kernels (sageattention._fused quant_per_block_int8_fuse_sub_mean_cuda / scale_fuse_quant_cuda / transpose_pad_permute_cuda / quant_per_warp_int8_cuda and sm89_compile.qk_int8_sv_f8_accum_f16_fuse_v_scale_attn_inst_buf, built with Matrix-Game's current-stream patch). No ROCm build of SageAttention exists: EmbeddedLLM/SageAttention-rocm is an unmodified copy of thu-ml/SageAttention 2.0.0-beta (no HIP changes on any branch; setup.py refuses without CUDA_HOME), and the sm89 attention kernel the presets use is not in 2.0.0-beta at all. Needs a SageAttention 2.2 HIP/ROCm port (inline PTX mma.sync e4m3/s8/s4, ldmatrix, cp.async; wgmma on sm90) as a separate intake. Scoped out of the Matrix-Game port by Jeff's Q2 = B ruling (2026-11-23); evidence in projects/Matrix-Game/notes.md (SageAttention check).
